entities.summary: Karen Movsziszian is an Armenian chess Grandmaster (1994). He played for Germany from 1993 to 1997 and lives in Spain. He won the Armenian Chess Championship in 1981, the European Senior Chess Championship (50+) in 2017 and the World Senior Chess Championship (50+) in 2018.
